termsMetaDescription: Read the terms and conditions for using Properlia's real estate platform and services.
termsSection1Body: By accessing or using Properlia's platform, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
termsSection2Body: Properlia provides a real estate platform connecting buyers, sellers, and investors in Puebla, Mexico. We offer property listings, advisory consultations, and related services. We do not guarantee the availability of any specific property.
termsSection3Body: You agree to provide accurate information when using our platform and not to use our services for any unlawful purpose. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
termsSection4Body: All content on this platform, including text, images, and logos, is the property of Properlia and may not be reproduced without written permission.
termsSection5Body: Properlia is not liable for any indirect or consequential damages arising from the use of our platform. Property information is provided for reference only and is subject to change.
termsSection6Body: Your use of our platform is also governed by our Privacy Policy. We collect and process personal data in accordance with applicable Mexican data protection laws (LFPDPPP).
termsSection7Body: These terms are governed by the laws of Mexico. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Puebla, Mexico.
termsSection8Body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of our platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
privacyMetaDescription: Learn how Properlia collects, uses, and protects your personal data in accordance with Mexican data protection law.
privacySection1Body: Properlia is responsible for the collection and processing of your personal data. Contact: contacto@properlia.com
privacySection2Body: We may collect your name, email address, phone number, and property preferences when you submit a consultation form or contact us through the platform.
privacySection3Body: Your data is used to respond to your inquiries, provide real estate advisory services, send relevant property information, and improve our platform.
privacySection4Body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with trusted service providers (e.g., CRM, analytics) solely to deliver our services, under confidentiality obligations.
privacySection5Body: We retain your data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described above or as required by law.
privacySection6Body: Under Mexico's LFPDPPP, you have the right to Access, Rectify, Cancel, or Object to the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at contacto@properlia.com.
privacySection7Body: Our platform uses cookies and analytics tools (including Google Analytics) to understand how visitors use the site. You may disable cookies through your browser settings.
privacySection8Body: We may update this privacy notice at any time. The updated version will be posted on this page with the revision date.
